questions.question_en: Which one of the following is not the description of the right of 'Equality' in the sense that the term is used in the context of the Preamble to the Constitution?
options_en: Every citizen is entitled to cast a vote
No undue distinction should be made between one person and another
All persons are to be treated equally before law
questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Reworded from UPSC CSP 2017 Q2; the answer here follows this wording (option 1). Answer: Every citizen is entitled to cast a vote. The 'equality' in the Preamble refers to equality of status and opportunity, including political equality. 'Every citizen is entitled to cast a vote' describes the right to vote, not strictly the concept of equality as used in the Preamble's sense.
